title: sycl-agent integration surface index
description: Last-mile backend-integration work items. A surface the project does not have is marked with a reason in `notes` or `status: waived` — never deleted, so coverage cannot be improved by shrinking the denominator.

id.description: Canonical surface id. Extra project-specific surfaces are allowed; the seven canonical ones should always be present.

status.description: waived = deliberately not done, with a waiver in readiness.json; deferred = in the residual work package; blocked = a prerequisite must be fixed first.

blocks_level.description: The lowest Backend Readiness Level this surface blocks while incomplete.

owner_archetype.description: Which archetypes have this surface (A..F, or 'all').

effort_weeks.description: [low, high] engineer-weeks for one experienced SYCL/C++ engineer.

prerequisite.description: Blocking item that must be fixed first (e.g. a kernel that segfaults on the backward path).

evidence.description: Run ids (evidence.sh record build|integration|test|e2e) backing this surface's completion.
